diagnosis_candidates.description: The Application class contains a static initialization block that explicitly sets the system property 'notification.channel' to 'legacy'. In Spring Boot, system properties have higher precedence than properties defined in application.yml. Consequently, the configured value 'pager' is overridden by the code-supplied value 'legacy' during property binding, causing the notification service to consume the wrong channel.
diagnosis_candidates.recommended_fix: Remove the static initialization block in the Application class that sets the 'notification.channel' system property, allowing Spring Boot to correctly bind the value from application.yml.
diagnosis_candidates.title: Static block in Application class overrides configured channel via System Property
